plan.title: Tie on Lowest Landed Price Highlights Both Vendors

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer side.
Reach the participant list so a surrogate bid can be entered for another invited vendor.
Submit a second vendor bid at the same landed price of 100 to create the tie.
Verify the second bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Verify both bidding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Verify the QCS ranking is based on the tied lowest amount for both vendors.
